app.name: Baidu DuMate
app.description: Baidu's general work agent (搭子DuMate) for desktop and mobile that runs multi-step office tasks across files, apps and the web.

observations.note: Baidu Q3 2026 earnings call (Nov 16, 2026), Robin Li's prepared remarks: 'DuMate, our general work agent introduced earlier this year, has grown rapidly. In September, its MAU increased by more than 30-fold quarter-over-quarter.' 30-fold recorded as +2900% (a floor: 'more than'); quarter-over-quarter recorded as 91 days. Growth of monthly active users (MAU); no level stated by Baidu. The call states only the month, so dated to Sept 30 (month end, following earlier files' convention for month-only figures); the call date is Nov 16. DuMate is a separately stated AI product of Baidu. Transcript page read with Tavily extract (Globe and Mail copy); BigGo's call summary says the same. The 9.77M September MAU on Baidu Baike is a QuestMobile third-party figure and is not recorded. [Daily-run review: re-dated to the Nov 16 call date; the source states only "September", and the rules forbid inferring a period end date.]

app.name: CodeRabbit
app.description: AI code review platform that reviews, triages and secures pull requests written by people and coding agents.

observations.note: CodeRabbit blog post by co-founders Harjot Gill and Gur Singh (Nov 12, 2026), 'CodeRabbit Passes $100 million in ARR': 'CodeRabbit has grown from $10 million to $100 million in annual recurring revenue in just over a year.' The Business Wire release of the same day says 'CodeRabbit has passed $100 million in annual recurring revenue.' $100M is a floor ('passed'). Basis (gross/net/contracted) not stated, so left out. The growth from $10M is over 'just over a year', which is not an exact window and is two levels, so no growth row. Page read with Tavily extract.
